## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins) 
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

bill_summary <- penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(), 
    mean_bill_length_mm = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 
    sd_bill_length_mm = sd(bill_length_mm), na.rm = TRUE
  )

ggplot(bill_summary, aes(x = species, y = mean_bill_length_mm, fill = species)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_bill_length_mm - sd_bill_length_mm,
                    ymax = mean_bill_length_mm + sd_bill_length_mm),
                width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Mean Bill Length by Species",
       x = "Species", y = "Mean bill length (mm)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
